purpose: Create the first clean-room host-neutral Song Structure Map: a manually authored, revisioned list of named Song sections with bar ranges and notes, visible and safely editable through /song without pretending to derive structure from audio or mutate the active DAW.

lineage.outcome: The artist can give the Song a durable portable arrangement map above individual DAWs, see where sections live by bar, revise mistakes without losing history, and later use that structure as context for host sync, generation, Focus, references and musical plans.
lineage.capability: Revisioned host-neutral Song section map / first Creative Studio structure canvas

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-006 Creative Studio and REQ-SCOPE-071 canonical Song maps are required, and fresh clean-room main has no section/map module. A portable manual section map is a bounded dependency for section-aware generation, FocusContext, host-neutral musical plans, derivation, References and addressable musical objects without requiring audio inference or one specific DAW.
instead_of: Friction capture remains useful but has lower portfolio leverage than establishing the missing canonical Song structure primitive used by multiple required producer journeys.
Automatic section derivation is not selected because uncertain audio analysis must remain a later evidence/proposal path rather than silently owning structure.
Direct DAW marker mutation is not selected because the canonical Song map must exist above hosts before adapter synchronization can be trusted.
Full waveform/timeline editing is not selected because N0TE orchestrates the Song above the DAW rather than replacing the DAW editor.
References and section-aware generation are not selected before a stable section identity/range model exists.

legacy_rejections: raw structure IDs in browser authority

completion_proof: canonical local persistence owns immutable structure revisions and one current revision pointer per Song
each section has artist-facing name, positive inclusive first/last bar range and optional note; sections are ordered and may not overlap
add/edit/remove operations create new revisions instead of rewriting prior structure history
undo restores the immediately prior structure by creating a new revision, preserving linear history rather than moving the pointer backward
all consumer writes bind exact active Song + exact rendered current structure revision behind opaque one-shot authority and stale state fails closed
removing a section changes only N0TE structure metadata and explicitly does not delete/move/cut Song material or DAW audio
normal /song shows the current portable structure in bar order and a bounded revision/undo state without internal revision IDs
Activity receives one Song-bound structure-revised event per committed revision and What changed? renders it in artist language
multiple Songs remain isolated and quit/relaunch preserves the same current structure/history
authored invariant/HTTP/security/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent observed execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After landing or blockage, globally reselect across remaining Creative Studio/map layers, FocusContext, Friction capture, References, interaction/teaching modes, derivation, DAW sync and other portfolio outcomes.
